fields.label: Alt Title
fields.value: Plan of the Fort of Beauséjour with the attack in June 1755.

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Manuscript map depicting the Fort of Beauséjour, later Fort Cumberland and showing the road to Bay Vert. Copied by Samuel Holland, probably in 1756, from an original by John Brewse.

fields.label: Notes
fields.value: Title from map. Relief shown pictorially. Scale given in bar graph 1 inch to 200 feet. North is to the upper left of the map. Date of situation: June 1755. Museum Book Store. A catalogue of maps of America from the middle of the sixteenth to the middle of the eighteenth centuries, 1924. No. 93, No. 320.
